input.title: Give the password field the accessible name "Password"
input.rationale: The password input (#su-pass) has no accessible name. The visible text "Password" on line 11 is in a <label> that has no for attribute and doesn't wrap the input, so the two aren't linked. I can only edit the input itself, so this adds aria-label="Password". That matches the visible label word for word, so screen reader and voice control users get the same name sighted users see. A cleaner fix in the source would be to add for="su-pass" to the <label> on line 11, which also makes clicking the label focus the field. If you make that change, remove this aria-label so the name isn't set in two places. This fixes this one finding only. It doesn't make the page compliant.
